claims: An enterprise agreement "must still leave you no worse off than this award overall."
"Many large cleaning contractors pay under an enterprise agreement."
whys: Under the Fair Work Act the test for an enterprise agreement is the better off overall test (BOOT): each employee must be better off overall than under the award. "No worse off" is the old no-disadvantage test, so the wording understates the legal rule. I did not change it because it is a legal claim.
This population claim has no figure and the page cites no source for it.
